profile.title: Profile Management
profile.subtitle: Your master profile, and the preferences and fingerprint built from it
profile.newProfileHint: Paste your CV or resume below, or use Import file to load an existing .md or .txt document into the editor.
profile.editHint: Edit your professional profile in Markdown format
profile.previewEmpty: Your profile is empty. Click Edit to add your professional background in Markdown.
profile.assistantHint: Ask the assistant to improve sections, add metrics, or reorganize your profile. When it suggests an update, use Apply to editor.
profile.fileTooLarge: File is too large (max 500KB). Consider splitting the content.
profile.import_unsupported: Unsupported file. Import a PDF, DOCX, Markdown or text file.
profile.import_legacyDoc: Old Word .doc files cannot be read. Save it as PDF or DOCX in Word and import that.
profile.import_noText: No text found in this file. It may be a scanned image; export the CV from its editor as PDF or DOCX instead.
profile.structureHint: Rewrite the editor text into profile sections with your model. Nothing is saved until you press Save.
profile.saveMasterFirst: Save the master profile first; preferences are built from the saved version.
profile.generateNoMaster: Write a master profile first; preferences are built from it.
profile.reviewGenerated: Generated from your master profile. Check every field, especially fields of work and skills, then save. Nothing is saved until you do.
profile.prefsDesc: Your hard limits and what you want to do. Flow uses the limits to exclude jobs you cannot take and the rest to pre-score; the fingerprint is built from this card.
profile.prefsStale: The master profile changed after these preferences were built or last edited.
profile.prefsEmpty: No preferences yet. Generate them from your master profile and review the result, or fill them in by hand.
profile.prefsUnknownPlaces: Not a known country or region, left out: {{places}}
profile.prefsLanguagesHint: Language names, with a level in brackets if you like: English (C1), Spanish (native).
profile.prefsWorkDesc: Used to pre-score jobs and to build the fingerprint. Plain words, comma-separated.
profile.prefs_fields_hint: Kinds of work you would do every day, not job titles (e.g. backend software engineering).
profile.prefs_skills_hint: Core technical and professional skills, most important first.
profile.prefs_domains_hint: Industries you have worked in or want to.
profile.prefs_titles_hint: One per line, with its language: Compliance Analyst (en). Flow searches each place with the titles in English and that place's languages.
profile.prefs_exclude_titles_hint: Words that mark a title you never want (e.g. intern). Flow archives these before scoring, comma-separated.
profile.titlesFailed: Preferences generated, but the job titles were not: {{error}}. Generate again or write them by hand.
profile.titlesTranslateFailed: Job titles generated, but the translation failed for: {{langs}}. Add those by hand or generate again.
profile.fingerprintDesc: One line used by the job-page overlay for quick scores. Render it from your preferences, or write it yourself.
profile.fingerprintNoPreferences: Save your preferences first; the fingerprint is rendered from them.
profile.fingerprintStale: Your preferences changed after this fingerprint was built or last edited.

config.title: Settings
config.secondaryUseDesc: How should the secondary model be used?
config.themeDesc: Light or dark appearance for this profile
config.autoSaveProfileDesc: Save profile edits to IndexedDB after you stop typing
config.localModelDesc: Download a model to run entirely in-browser via WebGPU. No API key or external server needed.
config.thinkingOffDesc: For reasoning models (Qwen 3.5, Gemma 4) that think before answering. Off makes them answer directly; some reply only after minutes otherwise.
config.webllm: Use Local Model (in-browser, no API key)
config.extensionNotAvailable: Extension settings are available when running as a Chrome extension.
config.showOverlay: Enable quick analysis on job sites
config.showOverlayDesc: Powers the floating badge and the side panel's automatic quick scoring on the sites below.
config.jobSitesDesc: The floating badge and automatic quick scoring appear on these sites when you visit job pages.
config.noJobSites: No job sites configured. Add one below.
config.sitePermissionMissing: Access not granted yet — the overlay won't appear on this site until it is.
config.sitePermissionMissingHint: Some sites are listed but the extension hasn't been granted access to them yet — click "Grant access" on each to make the overlay work there.
config.errorLogDesc: Captures errors from the app, LLM connections, overlay, and popup
config.dangerZoneDesc: Clear all data and reset the application to its factory state. This removes all profiles, analysis sessions, and settings. This action cannot be undone.
config.clearAllDataDesc: This will permanently delete all profiles, analysis sessions, settings, and error logs. The app will reset to factory state. This cannot be undone.
config.clearAllDataFailed: Failed to clear data. Your data has not been modified.
config.listModelsHint: Not sure of the exact model name? Click to fetch the models available from this endpoint.
config.noProvidersConfigured: No AI provider is configured. Go to Settings to set up an LLM endpoint.
config.webgpuCrash: WebGPU device crashed. Close other GPU-heavy tabs, restart Chrome, and try a smaller model.
config.overlayFallback: Overlay fallback (when Gemini Nano is unavailable)
config.overlayFallbackDesc: Which LLM path the overlay uses to score jobs when on-device Gemini Nano can't run.
config.fallbackSecondaryUnavailable: Configure a secondary endpoint in the LLM section above to use this option.
config.permissionDenied: Permission not granted — the overlay can't run on this site until it's approved.
config.flowDesc: Flow is a background service that searches and scores jobs on its own. Quiver keeps every setting, including Flow's, and sends them to Flow whenever they change or before it controls Flow. Quiver works fully without it.
config.flowNotFound: Could not reach Flow at this address. Check the host:port and that Flow is running.
config.flowProviderUnsupported: Flow only accepts Anthropic or OpenAI-compatible endpoints — this provider can't be sent.
config.flowStartReady: Flow holds your profile and settings and is ready to start.
config.flowStartBlocked: Waiting for the first sync to Flow.
config.flowBacklogDesc: Controls how large the "new" backlog is allowed to grow and when jobs get archived automatically.
config.flowSoftCapHint: Pauses searching while this many jobs are waiting to be scored; resumes on its own once scoring catches up. Turn off to never pause search.
config.flowHardCapHint: Autopilot stops searching once a run has found this many jobs at or above the minimum score below, then finishes scoring and turns off. Turn off to search until nothing new turns up.
config.flowHardCapMinScoreHint: Only jobs scoring at least this count toward the hard cap. Empty = the archive score threshold.
config.flowStaleNewDaysHint: Archive unscored/unactioned jobs that have sat this long, regardless of score.
config.flow_skip_aggregator_boards_hint: Don't fetch boards that relist other companies' jobs (listed in Flow's config/ats.yaml).
config.flowPrefsDesc: What applies to you. Flow judges each job's location and work mode against these. Anything left unset filters nothing.
config.flowPrefs_work_authorisation_hint: Country or region codes, comma-separated (e.g. EU, GB).
config.flowPrefs_remote_from_hint: Places you can be employed remotely from. Usually your home country or region.
config.flowPrefs_relocation_countries_hint: Hybrid and on-site jobs here count as reachable unless that mode is set to Never.
config.flowPrefs_languages_hint: Language names. Jobs requiring another language are ranked lower.
config.flowRulesDesc: Per-company limits the apply queue respects. Any past application to a company already blocks it; these add exceptions and quotas.
config.fingerprintMoved: The fingerprint the overlay uses is built and edited on the Profile page.
config.flowPrefsMoved: Your preferences (hard limits, languages, fields of work) are on the Profile page.
config.flowDataDesc: Export Flow's database, or import one. Flow saves a backup of its current database before any import, and refuses while search, ranking or autopilot is running.
config.flowDataClearConfirm: Delete every job, score, application and search strategy in Flow? Settings stay. Flow keeps a backup first; export too if you want a copy here.
config.flowDataImportDbConfirm: Replace everything Flow holds with this database? Flow keeps a backup of the current one.
config.flowDataImportCsvConfirm: Merge these jobs into Flow? Rows with the same id are overwritten. Flow keeps a backup first.
config.flowDataImportedDb: Imported: Flow now holds {{n}} jobs. Backup: {{backup}}
config.flowSyncNever: Flow has not been synced from Quiver yet.
config.flowFirstSync: This Flow already has settings that this profile has never seen. Import them into this profile, or replace them with this profile's settings?
config.flowOtherProfile: Flow holds the profile "{{name}}". Syncing replaces it with this one, and Flow will search and score for this profile from now on.
config.flowModelDesc: One of your endpoints. Only Anthropic and OpenAI-compatible endpoints work with Flow.
config.flowSoftHardHint: Optional. Leave empty to use the endpoint's model for both scoring passes.
config.flowApplyDesc: Limits for the assisted apply queue.
config.flowPrescoreDesc: Compare each job's card with your preferences first and deep-score only jobs above the threshold. Off until it has been measured against your labels.

flow.title: Artemis Flow
flow.subtitle: Not connected
flow.notConnectedDesc: Connect to Flow, send it your profile and an LLM config, then start it from Settings.
flow.controlUnavailable: Not available on this Flow instance yet.
flow.controlledByAutopilot: Controlled by Autopilot — stop it to take manual control.
flow.autopilotDesc: Chains search and scoring: search pauses while the scoring queue is at the soft cap, and stops once a run has found enough good jobs (hard cap) or nothing new turns up.
flow.captureDesc: Opens jobs with no description in a background tab, reads the posting and sends it to Flow. One page every 30–90 s, never LinkedIn. Runs while this page is open.
flow.capturePermissionDenied: Site access is needed to read career pages.
flow.autopilotRunning: Running — tick {{ticks}}, {{backlog}} job(s) queued to score.
flow.autopilotHardCapReached: Hard cap reached — search stopped, finishing the scoring queue.
flow.autopilotStoppedHardCap: Stopped: this run found enough jobs to meet the hard cap. Start again to look for more.
flow.autopilotStoppedExhausted: Stopped: every search strategy is exhausted for now. Refine the strategy or wait for new listings.
flow.autopilotStoppedNoStrategy: Stopped: no search strategy available yet. Generate one from your profile in the Strategy tab.
flow.autopilotStoppedError: Stopped: an error interrupted the loop. Check Flow's logs.
flow.boardsDesc: Searches fetch only active boards. A sweep checks the rest once and activates those with matching roles you can take.
flow.boardsNone: No boards yet — run a sweep with “Refresh board lists” ticked.
flow.boardsLastSweep: Last sweep: {{checked}} checked, {{promoted}} activated, {{inserted}} jobs found.
flow.suggestionRemoteHint: Focus the search on fully remote roles
flow.suggestionEuropeHint: Include Italy and the rest of Europe
flow.strategyVersion: Version {{v}} — this is what the next search run will use
flow.strategyLoadFailed: Could not load the search strategy.
flow.strategyNone: No strategy generated yet. Regenerate from your profile or send feedback via chat to create one.
flow.archiveDesc: Archived duplicates and low-fit jobs. Restore any of these before they're permanently purged after the retention window.
flow.brokenJobUrl: broken link — source returned a relative URL
flow.applyDesc: Builds a queue of your best new jobs in a score range, checked against your application history, company rules and preferences. Start applying opens the first job without an outcome; work through the rest in the side panel. Quiver never submits a form.
flow.applyUnrecorded: {{n}} outcome(s) not yet recorded in Flow.
flow.applyOverridePrompt: Why apply to {{company}} despite the block? This is recorded with the application.
flow.alignScoreHint: Card pre-score: below the threshold, so not deep-scored.

onboarding.jobAnalysisDesc: Paste a job posting, get detailed analysis and match scoring against your profile.
onboarding.cvLettersDesc: Generate tailored CVs and cover letters using your profile and AI.
onboarding.chromeExtDesc: Get match scores on job sites with the optional browser extension.
onboarding.local100Desc: Your profile, CVs, and job history are stored only in your browser. AI processing uses whichever provider you choose — from fully local (WebLLM/LM Studio) to cloud (OpenRouter, Anthropic, Gemini).
onboarding.connectAIDesc: Choose how Artemis connects to an AI model for analysis and generation.
onboarding.listModelsHint: Not sure of the exact model name? Click the list icon to fetch the models available from this endpoint.
onboarding.buildProfileDesc: Paste your resume or professional summary. This is what Artemis uses to analyze job fit.
onboarding.profileAutoSaved: Your profile is auto-saved. You can always edit it later from the Profile page.

apply.cvFolderDesc: Your CVs, listed in the side panel so you can attach them to applications. Save CVs you export from Quiver into the “{{sub}}” subfolder — Chrome's Save-as-PDF dialog remembers the last folder you used.
apply.folderUnsupported: Linking a folder needs Chrome or Edge.
apply.formProfileDesc: Answers for application forms. “fields” are standard fields (aliases are the form labels that match them, learned as you fill), “answers” are saved answers to recurring questions with a scope (“always”, or a region such as US/EU/UK), “rules” is free text the drafting model reads (e.g. “I need visa sponsorship for US roles, not for EU roles”).
apply.seedDesc: Fills empty values from your profile with the configured model. Nothing is saved until you press Save — check the values first.
